Il lessico BI-RADS per l'ecografia descr:
The BI-RADS ultrasound lexicon describes a mass with a few words: shape (oval, round, irregular), orientation (parallel to the skin = wider than tall; not parallel = taller than wide), margins (circumscribed, or indistinct, angular, microlobulated, spiculated), echo pattern (anechoic, hypoechoic, complex…) and posterior features (enhancement, shadowing, none).
Ultrasound signs of malignancy are: irregular shape, non-circumscribed margins (spiculated, angular, microlobulated, indistinct), non-parallel orientation (taller than wide), posterior shadowing. Even a single sign means at least BI-RADS 4.
With several classic signs together the category is 5. BI-RADS 4 and 5 lesions undergo percutaneous biopsy; a benign result on a BI-RADS 5 lesion is discordant and must be reviewed.
Here biopsy confirmed invasive ductal carcinoma, the most common breast cancer.
